title: IoT / LLM request log
description: One approved JSON event per observed model request, including provider usage, duration, streaming TTFT and policy categories. Prompt, answer and credentials are excluded by the application schema.

options.content: Expand a JSON row to read **request_id**, **usage.prompt_tokens**, **usage.completion_tokens**, **usage.total_tokens**, **duration_seconds**, **ttft_seconds**, **policy_categories** and the actual HTTP result. Nonstreaming TTFT is null. Request and trace IDs remain fields, never Loki labels. This log contains approved model events only; it is not a full transcript.

panels.title: Observed model requests
panels.description: Native CRI timestamps and original approved JSON; expand a row for all fields.
